rulesData.meta: Search, Study, Utilize, and ability checks
rulesData.summary: Secret passage: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to notice or Intelligence (Investigation) to deduce. Locked door: DC 15 Dexterity using Thieves’ Tools or DC 15 Strength (Athletics) to force. Trapped door: notice and disable using the trap’s listed DCs.
